Ag Secretary Brooke Rollins cheered on 4.3 million Americans losing SNAP benefits thanks to Trump's Big Ugly Bill.

That's the biggest drop in food assistance in nearly 30 years — all to give the ultra-rich even more tax cuts.

A gallon of gas is now 50% more expensive than when Trump started his Iran War. In the war's first month, the 100 biggest oil and gas companies brought in an extra $30 million per HOUR in windfall profits. Trump's Big Oil donors come out on top while the world suffers.

Republicans want $1 BILLION in new taxpayer funding to shore up security for Trump's White House ballroom.

And don't forget: Corporate donations to construct the ballroom will be tax-deductible.

Trump is sticking us with the tab for his vanity project while ignoring what the country really needs.
The greatest honor of my life wasn't serving in the Cabinet. It was being a teacher.

A new ABC/Ipsos poll finds that 59% of Americans believe Trump is mentally unfit to serve as commander-in-chief. 

More and more people are acknowledging what is painfully obvious: Donald Trump has completely lost his mind.

94% of teachers have to dip into their own pockets to buy school supplies.

85% of teachers are working second jobs during the school year, often just to keep up with the cost of living.

Meanwhile, the average Wall Street employee got a bonus of $246,900 in 2025.

Something has gone terribly wrong.

The Spirit Airlines demise is a direct result of the Iran war's impact on jet fuel. Wall St Dems who know that yet still blame a 2-year-old merger challenge, which if it didn't happen would've just led to a bigger airline going bankrupt, are being extremely disingenuous.
